title: Jason’s House meditation
details: Chapter 1 only. Lucia can offer a meditation lesson at Jason’s house. It adds one to the meditation counter. Its requirement for the Positive Mental Attitude trophy is still unconfirmed.
steps: During Chapter 1, speak with Lucia in the kitchen when the optional interaction becomes available.
Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation lesson before leaving Chapter 1.
evidenceNote: The guide shows the lesson on the balcony. The pin uses the named house venue from GTADB.

title: Smooth Sand meditation
details: Use the spot once as Jason and once as Lucia. Character switching becomes available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
steps: Cross to the sandbar off the west side of Capri.
Look for the mat on the sand.
evidenceNote: The selected game map marker aligns to the atlas using 330 inliers. The held-out p90 residual is 3.04 atlas pixels. Use the in-game prompt for the exact interaction.
